# Fiberglass: You can find it here for the challenges

Fiberglass is a type of glass fiber reinforced plastic that can be processed into all sorts of shapes. Fiberglass can be used for crafting armor, weapons and power armor, it is also required for some weapon mods and camp items.

## Scrap items that contain fiberglass

- Abraxo cleaner
- Aluminum canister
- Blood bag
- Cigar box
- Composite skis
- Fiberglass reel
- Industrial cleaner
- Jangles the Moon Monkey
- Rat poison
- Telephone

## Map with locations for fiberglass

A list of places would be far too long, so I put together a map with the appropriate items using Mappalachia.

*Tip: Pleasant Valley huts are always a good place to go for composite skis*

See also: Fallout 76 Wiki
